fields.assessment_notes: The Crimson Guild is now a better-supported mid-distance event candidate than the older Commander-only read suggested: the 2026-07-24 Wizards/EventLink snapshot confirms Friday free Commander, Friday Pauper FNM, Wednesday Draft, Sunday Standard Showdown, and a July 31 Marvel Commander Party. The practical visit read is still cautious-positive rather than home-base: Friday Commander is the best first-visit Commander candidate, but actual turnout, proxy/power norms, solo-arrival support, and any Discord/community route remain unresolved; the public official site is active/identity-useful but schedule-thin compared with WPN.

operations.reason: Refresh Crimson Guild venue-level source and assessment text after current WPN reconciliation.

fields.assessment_notes: A & N now has current Wizards/EventLink support for Monday, Wednesday, and Friday free Commander plus three Hobbit prerelease sessions, so it is not merely a stale Commander lead. Friday FNM Commander is the cleanest first-visit Commander lane on schedule regularity, while Hobbit prerelease weekend gives a structured limited-event way to sample the store. The caution remains practical: San Dimas is a deliberate 25.7-mile trip, public social routes were not content-readable in this pass, no Discord/community route is known, and prior review mirrors conflict on how strong the in-store-play experience is.

operations.reason: Refresh a-and-n-collectibles venue-level assessment after corrected main-pass source reconciliation.

fields.assessment_notes: Next-Gen now reads as a broad WPN Premium Magic hub with enough event breadth to justify keeping it visible despite distance: current WPN confirms Wednesday Commander, Sunday all-day Commander, Tuesday Draft, Tuesday Modern, Saturday drafts, Friday Modern, Monday Standard, Thursday Legacy, 2HG Commander, Hobbit prerelease weekend, Hobbit Commander Party, and Heart of the Mountain. Best first-visit candidates may be structured draft/prerelease/specials rather than ordinary Commander until Discord/LFG or a visit clarifies casual Commander texture.

fields.assessment_notes: Comic Quest remains a useful but cautious Lake Forest candidate. The 2026-07-24 WPN snapshot confirms Friday FNM Commander, short-run FNM Standard Showdown, Marvel Commander Party, Hobbit prerelease sessions, Hobbit Commander Parties, and Heart of the Mountain; no current WPN support was found for God of Mischief. Official newcomer/open-play language remains a positive, but the review-derived locals-only caution and distance keep it from being an obvious first target without confirming non-regular walk-in friendliness.
